openings.claim: Envelope pattern/count marks and insertion ticks may address quantity-memory omissions; exterior identity may separately reduce assignment exchanges. O4 challenges shared-tray necessity.
openings.discriminator: Accurate uncued local staging versus omissions and frequent crossings with marked shared trays defeats memory dominance; ticked incomplete envelopes defeat insertion checking.
openings.probe: Within 18 minutes including preparation/audit, alternate three matched four-kit batches: incumbent, marked/ticked shared-tray, uncued local staging. Audit against samples; tally crossings, omissions and all times. Stop if staging exceeds the table.
openings.uncertainty: Mark legibility, matched mixture, staging footprint and probe-cap feasibility are unknown; omission stage and 60-kit benefit remain unresolved.

openings.claim: Two table lanes with limited counted pattern-specific local batches may reduce interference, omissions and elapsed time. Mark exterior pattern and check before closing; retain tags/samples.
openings.discriminator: Matched mixtures yielding unchanged/worse omissions and total time despite fewer crossings defeat causal benefit. Easier mixtures or short-session attention could explain O4; table overflow defeats implementation.
openings.probe: Use first twelve required kits as comparable six-kit shared-tray/local batches; balance patterns/volunteers where feasible. Verify lanes fit; count staging, picking, filling and immediate checking on the same 90-minute clock. Record pre-correction omissions/crossings; retain corrected kits. Stop if remaining completion is threatened.
openings.uncertainty: Preservation applies only to this bounded probe. Comparable mixtures, footprint and full-run benefit remain unconfirmed.

decision: Choose a bounded probe; neither establishes improvement. All evidence is authored synthetic. Require 60 kits within 90 minutes, at most one distribution correction, exact pattern quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, envelopes/supplies and no purchases/equipment. Open-packet footprint and supply-shortage/access uncertainty persist. Full-run validation remains necessary.
